name: The Haunted Mills
summary: Coleman Farthing of Brill seeks vengeance on the Agamands, his former landowners. He sends you north to Agamand Mills to destroy their restless remains, beginning with Devlin, the family’s sharp-tongued younger son. Farthing’s hatred reaches back to the family’s failure to protect Tirisfal’s common folk from the Plague.

sections.title: A Bitter Harvest
sections.body: Before the Third War, Agamand Mills fed northern Tirisfal under the rule of a wealthy landed family. When the Scourge swept across Lordaeron, common folk turned to the nobles for safety and found no shelter. Coleman Farthing survived as undead, but hatred for the family he served still consumes him. He wants their bones gathered, not to end their torment, but to desecrate them beneath his heel.

sections.title: The Younger Brother
sections.body: Devlin Agamand was Thurman Agamand’s younger brother. People remembered Devlin as weak, spiteful, and sharp-tongued, unlike his gentle elder brother. When the Plague of Undeath reached the mill estate, Devlin quickly fell to its corruption. Now his mindless corpse chatters without cease along the northern road into the family mills.

faq.q: Why does Coleman Farthing want Devlin's remains?
faq.answer: Coleman Farthing blames the Agamands for abandoning him and his relatives when the Scourge overran Lordaeron. In undeath, he seeks revenge by gathering their bones to display on his mantle and grind into dust.

faq.q: Where can Devlin Agamand be found?
faq.answer: Devlin wanders near the road just south of Agamand Mills in northern Tirisfal Glades, gibbering among the undead that prowl the estate’s outskirts.

faq.q: What was Devlin like before the Plague?
faq.answer: Coleman Farthing describes Devlin as the smaller, weaker, sharp-tongued younger son of the Agamands, unlike his tall, mild-mannered older brother Thurman.

faq.q: Is Devlin part of the Scourge or Forsaken?
faq.answer: Devlin is a mindless thrall of the Scourge. He never broke free of the Lich King’s grip as the Forsaken of the Undercity did, and now stalks his family’s ruined lands.

faq.q: What other quests take place at Agamand Mills?
faq.answer: Deaths in the Family also sends Forsaken adventurers to Agamand Mills to eliminate the rest of the Agamand household, so you can pursue both at once.

faq.q: What happens after turning in Devlin's remains?
faq.answer: After accepting the bones, Coleman Farthing sends you to speak with Sevren in Brill. That leads deeper into the Agamand family crypt.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you see how the fall of Lordaeron left mortal grudges alive. The landed nobles failed to protect the common folk from the Plague, and resentment remains.
As Horde, you help the Forsaken purge dangerous Scourge from the borders of Brill and Undercity.
